blind.B1: Yes. Forced treadmill experiment in 10-wk-old male C57BL/6J, renal cortex bulk RNA-seq (S2.1.p3, S2.8.p1, S3.4.p1). Sequenced samples with the exercise factor: 24 h (post-ECT, no training, euthanized 24 h after exhaustive test), 1 wk and 2 wk trained groups; Sed are controls. GEO treatment_protocol and 'Ex_*' titles agree. Voluntary-wheel experiment has no RNA-seq.
blind.B2: 2 wk vs Sed, 1 wk vs Sed, 24 h vs Sed (TAB1, S3.4.p1); n=4 per group (FIG6 legend; GEO 16 samples = 4 x 4). Primary: 2 wk vs Sed (TAB2).
blind.B3: No repeated measures for RNA-seq: separate animals per group, one kidney cortex sample each (S2.1.p3, S3.4.p1). Pre/post ECT is within-animal but only one RNA sample per animal. Packet A pairing-key table finds no key linking samples (0/16); the only repeated column is the treatment label itself.
blind.B4: Paper does not say whether one 4-group model or pairwise fits were used (S2.9.p1 only: DESeq2, RLE, genes <10 counts removed, BH p<=0.05).
blind.B5: S2.9.p1: 'all P values were adjusted ... (Benjamini-Hochberg procedure; p<=0.05)'; TAB1/TAB2 header: p<=0.05; q<=0.05; |log2FC|>=0 (no fold-change cutoff, inclusive). Counts: 2 wk 24 (17 up/7 down), 1 wk 0, 24 h 54 (34 up/20 down).

checks.evidence: S2.1.p3, S3.4.p1; run proceeds on the in-vivo treadmill series with Sed control.

16 GSM = 4 groups x 4 (FIG6 n=4); grp recode Control->SED, 24 h->H24, 1 wk->W1, 2 wk->W2 cross-checked by group token in library name; 8 extra matrix columns (STC804_17..24) without GSM dropped and recorded as discrepancy.

Contrasts grp_W2/W1/H24_vs_SED with SED control, treatment=exercise; matches TAB2 sign convention (2 wk vs Sed). The three possible_reversed_contrast flags are false positives (control=SED, treatment=exercise group).
No repeated animals (B3); packet A candidate keys link 0/16 samples. The unused_subject_like_column flag is the treatment label itself, not an animal ID.

Paper silent (B4); joint ~grp model is primary and pairwise 2 wk vs Sed is reported as sensitivity (29 vs 93 DEGs vs paper 24). Both fits reported as required. Joint vs pairwise remains an open policy question.

Group is the only varying factor; animals group-housed (S2.1.p3), all male, sex check one sex. Sequencing run/batch not recorded in GEO; 'B<k>' tokens in library names are not documented as batch. Note that run/lane is unknown.
HTSeq raw counts, integer fraction 1.0, DESeq2 route matches S2.9.p1; p-value histogram not piled (frac_p_gt_0.9 ~0.10). Gene universe (no protein-coding restriction) recorded as declared deviation.

BH padj<=0.05, no LFC cutoff, inclusive, as S2.9.p1 and TAB1. Packet B table: no alternative rule reproduces 24/0/54 across all three contrasts (padj<0.05&|lfc|>0.585 gives 23/12/47), so no threshold discrepancy to record.

Same contrasts compared with TAB1 counts; discrepancies (29 vs 24, 14 vs 0, 74 vs 54) reported, 1 wk discrepancy flagged as unresolved. HANDBACK inference that the paper 'fitted one 4-group model' rests only on the 2 wk count and is weak given 1 wk (14 vs 0) and 24 h mismatches; wording could be softened. Executed-formula label '~ cell' vs design '~ grp' is cosmetic.
No stop or refusal; case completed.

human_items: Open policy: joint vs pairwise fit when paper is silent (counts differ 29 vs 93); paper's counts are closer to the joint fit but do not fully match either.
summary: 该案例设计、分组、对比方向、阈值和矩阵方法均与论文一致，没有重复测量，也没有停止或拒绝的决定。三个possible_reversed_contrast标记和unused_subject_like_column标记均为误报。DEG数量与论文不完全一致（29对24、14对0、74对54），已如实记录；总体通过。
